final: SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS manager_award_count, CAST(COUNT(ma.player_id) AS REAL) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manager_award), 0) AS fraction_of_total FROM player AS p LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.player_id ORDER BY fraction_of_total DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
